summary: Cipher Digital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the October 16, 2026 issuance of $850.0 million principal of 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032 under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust, plus a 13-day option for up to $150 million more. The notes are senior unsecured, non-interest-bearing, maturing November 1, 2032, convertible only on conditions before August 1, 2032, then anytime, settled in cash, stock or both. This is a routine convertible financing alongside an exchange of 2030 notes, not a special situation; watch conversion terms and debt-stack subordination.
